title: Ground Crew ABC
hook: Ground crew coordinates before the aircraft moves again.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D civilian aviation storybook, toy aircraft and ground gear, clean sky scenes; visual identity: Ground Crew ABC

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child observing ground operations from a safe public area
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: aircraft/ground object -> turnaround role -> professional boundary
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Ground Crew ABC a turnaround sequence: arrival, parking guidance, baggage/cargo, fuel/maintenance/security checks, boarding, and departure; ground equipment and people are distinct from flight controls.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child watches through terminal glass as trained teams perform coordinated jobs inside a safety zone.
